verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (can → headline → Shop Now). But the can is undersized, and the logo and 'Sparkling botanicals' are shrunk to tiny type and pushed into a stray cluster at bottom centre, far from the headline, which leaves dead space around them. B puts the Shop Now button before the headline and almost touching it, so the reading order is backwards and the two elements nearly collide. In B the subtitle is also tiny and stranded far below, and the product can is a small fragment wedged against the right edge, partly over the decorative circle.
